condition.zh: 瓣膜病 · 心臟團隊會議

tagline.zh: 不開刀的一天，決定比開刀還難
tagline.en: A day without operating, and a decision harder than any operation

desc.zh: 門診日。沒有開刀，只有一個比開刀更難的問題：這位阿嬤該換哪一種瓣膜，還是不換？
desc.en: A clinic day. No operating, just a question harder than any operation: which valve for this grandmother, or none at all?

desc.zh: 量步行速度、看她從椅子站起來幾次、教術後病人怎麼保護胸骨。衰弱不是一個印象，是一組數據。
desc.en: Gait speed, chair stands, and teaching post-op patients to protect the sternum. Frailty is not an impression; it is a set of measurements.

role.zh: 心臟外科主治醫師（師傅）

about.zh: 在心臟團隊會議上永遠先問：「病人想要什麼？」再看片子。抽屜裡有一塊練打結的板子。
about.en: At every heart-team meeting he asks first, "What does the patient want?", and only then looks at the scans. Keeps a knot-tying board in his drawer.

role.zh: 結構性心臟病內科醫師

about.zh: 做經導管瓣膜的內科醫師。和蘇主治吵了十年，吵出一個很好的團隊。
about.en: The cardiologist who does catheter valves. Has argued with Dr Su for ten years, and built a very good team out of it.

about.zh: 排檢查、追報告、提醒每個人病人下次什麼時候來。會議資料她最早到。
about.en: Books tests, chases results, reminds everyone when the patient is next due. First into every meeting with the papers.

role.zh: 病人・84 歲退休裁縫師

about.zh: 爬樓梯到頂樓種菜會喘，上個月在教會唱詩班站著昏倒一次。孫女春天結婚，嫁衣要自己做。
about.en: Breathless climbing to her rooftop vegetable garden; fainted standing in the church choir last month. Her granddaughter marries in spring, and she means to sew the dress herself.

about.zh: 護理系畢業，現在做業務。把阿嬤每一次喘都記在手機裡。
about.en: Trained as a nurse, now in sales. Logs every breathless spell of her grandmother's on her phone.

role.zh: 病人・42 歲廚師，換瓣術後六週
role.en: Patient, 42, chef, six weeks after valve surgery

about.zh: 天生二葉主動脈瓣，六週前換了機械瓣。最想知道什麼時候可以再甩炒鍋。
about.en: Born with a bicuspid aortic valve; a mechanical valve six weeks ago. Mostly wants to know when he can toss a wok again.

about.zh: 每個要換瓣膜的病人都先經過她的椅子。
about.en: Every patient bound for a new valve passes through her chair first.

plain.zh: 心臟出口的瓣膜鈣化變窄，心臟要很用力才擠得出血。
plain.en: The valve at the heart's exit calcifies and narrows, so the heart strains to push blood out.

plain.zh: 從大腿動脈送一個摺疊的瓣膜到心臟撐開，不用開胸。
plain.en: A folded valve sent up from the groin artery and expanded inside the old one, without opening the chest.

plain.zh: 開胸、上體外循環，把舊瓣膜剪掉、縫上新的。
plain.en: Open the chest, go on bypass, cut out the old valve and sew in a new one.

plain.zh: 心臟外科、心臟內科、影像、麻醉一起討論，再和病人一起決定。
plain.en: Surgeons, cardiologists, imaging and anaesthesia discuss together, then decide with the patient.

plain.zh: 身體的儲備變少，一點壓力就倒下。和年齡有關，但不等於年齡。
plain.en: Reduced physical reserve, so small stresses topple you. Linked to age, but not the same thing.

plain.zh: 走一小段固定距離要多久。很簡單，卻很能預測手術後恢復。
plain.en: How long it takes to walk a short fixed distance. Simple, yet it predicts recovery after surgery well.

plain.zh: 細菌黏在心臟瓣膜上的感染。人工瓣膜一旦感染，很難治。
plain.en: Infection of the heart valves by bacteria. Once an artificial valve is infected, it is very hard to treat.

plain.zh: 換瓣膜前先把蛀牙、牙周膿瘍處理好，減少細菌進入血液。
plain.en: Treat decay and gum abscesses before valve surgery, so fewer bacteria reach the blood.

plain.zh: 很耐用的人工瓣膜，但要終身吃抗凝血藥，防止血栓。
plain.en: A very durable artificial valve that needs lifelong anticoagulation against clots.

plain.zh: 開胸後胸骨還在癒合，一段時間內避免用力推、拉、提重物。
plain.en: After the chest is opened the breastbone is still healing, so heavy pushing, pulling and lifting are avoided for a while.

plain.zh: 醫師說明選項與利弊，病人說出在乎什麼，一起選。
plain.en: The doctor sets out the options and trade-offs, the patient says what matters, and they choose together.

plain.zh: 血流經過窄瓣膜時的「咻咻」聲。主動脈瓣狹窄的雜音會傳到脖子。
plain.en: The whoosh of blood through a narrowed valve. The murmur of aortic stenosis carries up into the neck.

plain.zh: 讓血管放鬆的藥。出口很窄的心臟，血管一擴張血壓就垮。
plain.en: Drugs that relax the blood vessels. With a tight valve at the exit, opening the vessels makes the pressure collapse.

text.zh: 看瓣膜開多大、血流多快、心臟多厚。狹窄的程度看這裡。
text.en: Shows how far the valve opens, how fast blood jets through and how thick the heart is. Severity is judged here.

text.zh: 蘇主治抽屜裡的木板。他說換一個瓣膜要打很多結，每一個都要一樣好。
text.en: The board in Dr Su's drawer. A valve takes a great many knots, he says, and every one must be as good as the first.

text.zh: 超音波、電腦斷層、冠狀動脈攝影、衰弱評估，全部同時放上來。
text.en: Echo, CT, coronary angiogram and frailty scores, all up at once.

text.zh: 阿嬤用鉛筆畫的，袖口有一朵小玉蘭。她說這是她的「治療目標」。
text.en: Pencilled by Grandma, with a small magnolia at the cuff. Her "treatment goal", she says.

text.zh: 每次抽血的結果和日期。旁邊用原子筆寫著：「機械瓣，藥不能停。」
text.en: Every blood result and date. In biro down the side: "Mechanical valve. Never stop the tablets."

name.en: Once symptoms appear, the clock starts

text.zh: 主動脈瓣狹窄可以安靜很多年。一旦出現三個症狀之一——用力時喘、胸悶、昏倒——不處理的預後就很差。所以問診要問活動量：爬幾層樓、走多遠、最近有沒有變少。老人家常常是「少做一點」來避開症狀，而不是沒有症狀。
text.en: Aortic stenosis can stay silent for years. Once one of three symptoms appears — breathlessness on effort, chest tightness, fainting — the outlook without treatment is poor. So ask about activity: how many flights, how far, any recent decline. Older people often avoid symptoms by quietly doing less, not by having none.

name.zh: 經導管還是開刀：不是年齡二選一
name.en: Catheter or surgery: not just a question of age

text.zh: 心臟團隊會一起看：年齡與預期壽命、手術風險分數、衰弱、瓣膜與血管解剖（大腿動脈夠不夠粗、鈣化在哪）、是否同時有冠狀動脈或其他瓣膜要處理，以及病人自己的目標。高齡、衰弱、解剖適合的人，經導管常是好選擇；年輕、低風險或解剖不適合的人，外科置換仍有優勢。
text.en: The heart team weighs age and life expectancy, surgical risk scores, frailty, valve and vessel anatomy (are the groin arteries big enough, where is the calcium), any coronary or other valve disease that also needs fixing, and the patient's own goals. For older, frailer patients with suitable anatomy a catheter valve is often a good choice; for younger, lower-risk patients or unsuitable anatomy, surgery keeps its advantages.

name.zh: 機械瓣與一輩子的抗凝
name.en: A mechanical valve and lifelong anticoagulation

text.zh: 機械瓣幾乎不會磨損，代價是終身吃抗凝血藥並定期抽血監測。不能自己停藥，新型口服抗凝藥不適用於機械瓣。小傷口壓久一點，大出血、黑便、劇烈頭痛要馬上就醫。看牙前告訴牙醫，依指引評估預防性抗生素。
text.en: A mechanical valve barely wears, at the price of lifelong anticoagulation with regular blood monitoring. Never stop on your own, and the newer oral anticoagulants are not for mechanical valves. Press small cuts for longer; heavy bleeding, black stools or a severe headache need urgent care. Tell the dentist, and antibiotic prophylaxis is considered per guideline.

note.zh: 今天門診兩個主角：一個瓣膜要換，一個剛換完
note.en: Two stars today: one valve to replace, one just replaced

guide.en: Find Dr Su at the board

lines.zh: 早。今天沒有刀，只有一個比刀更難的決定。秀琴阿嬤，84 歲，主動脈瓣狹窄。
lines.en: Morning. No operating today, just a decision harder than an operation. Grandma Hsiu-chin, 84, aortic stenosis.

lines.zh: 主動脈瓣狹窄的三個症狀？
lines.en: The three symptoms of aortic stenosis?

lines.zh: 用力時喘、胸悶、昏倒。
lines.en: Breathless on effort, chest tightness, fainting.

lines.zh: 她三個都有。症狀出現，時鐘就開始走了。去把超音波準備好。
lines.en: She has all three. Once symptoms appear, the clock is running. Get the echo machine ready.

q.zh: 找到診間的心臟超音波

post.zh: 阿嬤的電腦斷層、冠狀動脈攝影都排好了，中午會議資料我會先放上去。
post.en: Grandma's CT and coronary angiogram are done. I'll have the meeting slides up by noon.

note.zh: 症狀確定；衰弱評估完成

lines.zh: 醫師，我以前一口氣爬到頂樓種菜，現在要停兩次。
lines.en: Doctor, I used to go straight up to the roof to my vegetables. Now I stop twice.

lines.zh: 上個月在教會唱詩班站著，突然就倒了。我手機裡都有記。
lines.en: Last month she was standing in the choir and just went down. It's all logged on my phone.

lines.zh: 阿嬤，我聽一下心臟。這個咻咻的心雜音一路傳到脖子。
lines.en: Grandma, let me listen. This whooshing murmur carries all the way up to the neck.

lines.zh: 我自己也聽得到，晚上枕頭裡咻咻叫。
lines.en: I can hear it myself, whooshing in my pillow at night.

post.zh: 瓣膜病人要多看幾樣：超音波、冠狀動脈、電腦斷層的血管路徑，還有牙齒。
post.en: Valve patients need extras: the echo, the coronaries, the CT access route, and the teeth.

lines.zh: 阿嬤，從這條線走到那條線，用平常的速度就好。
lines.en: Grandma, walk from this line to that one, your normal pace.

lines.zh: 我走路很快的，以前送衣服都用跑的。
lines.en: I walk fast. I used to run the clothes round to customers.

lines.zh: 再來，雙手抱胸，從椅子站起來坐下，越快越好。最後握這個握力器。
lines.en: Now arms crossed, stand up from the chair and sit down, as fast as you can. Then squeeze this grip meter.

post.zh: 步行速度稍慢、握力還不錯。衰弱：輕度。她穿針不用戴眼鏡。
post.en: Gait speed a little slow, grip good. Frailty: mild. And she threads a needle without glasses.

post.zh: 那個要寫進去喔，很重要。

lines.zh: 把她的資料放進手術風險分數。分數不是答案，是會議的一個聲音。
lines.en: Put her details into the surgical risk scores. A score isn't the answer; it's one voice at the meeting.

lines.zh: 年齡、腎功能、肺功能、活動量、緊急程度。分數落在中等風險。
lines.en: Age, kidneys, lungs, mobility, urgency. The score lands at intermediate risk.

lines.zh: 阿嬤，如果治療順利，妳最想做什麼？
lines.en: Grandma, if the treatment goes well, what do you most want to do?

lines.zh: 小雯春天結婚。嫁衣我要自己做，袖口要繡一朵玉蘭。
lines.en: Wen marries in spring. I'm sewing the dress myself, with a magnolia on the cuff.

lines.zh: 阿嬤，妳先顧好自己啦。
lines.en: Grandma, look after yourself first.

lines.zh: 這就是在顧自己。
lines.en: This is looking after myself.

note.zh: 下排臼齒有膿瘍：先拔牙，再換瓣
note.en: An abscessed molar: tooth first, valve second

sub.zh: 陳醫師：「秀琴阿嬤的牙，換瓣前要先處理。」
sub.en: Dr Chen: "Grandma Hsiu-chin's tooth must be dealt with before the valve."

lines.zh: 左下臼齒根尖有膿瘍，要拔。拔完傷口好了再換瓣膜比較安全。
lines.en: Abscess at the root of a lower left molar; it has to come out. Safer to replace the valve once that socket has healed.

lines.zh: 人工瓣膜一感染就是心內膜炎，很難治。先把細菌的家拆掉。
lines.en: An infected artificial valve means endocarditis, and that's very hard to treat. Take down the bacteria's house first.

lines.zh: 對。拔牙那天我會照心臟團隊的建議評估預防性抗生素。
lines.en: Exactly. On extraction day I'll consider prophylactic antibiotics per the heart team's advice.

post.zh: 牙科篩檢不是行政流程。我見過一顆牙毀掉一個好瓣膜。
post.en: Dental clearance is not paperwork. I've seen one tooth ruin a good valve.

note.zh: 外科、內科、影像一起看，建議帶回給病人
note.en: Surgery, cardiology and imaging agree a recommendation to take back

lines.zh: 秀琴阿嬤，84 歲，症狀性嚴重主動脈瓣狹窄，輕度衰弱，牙科處理中。
lines.en: Grandma Hsiu-chin, 84, symptomatic severe aortic stenosis, mild frailty, dental work under way.

lines.zh: 電腦斷層我來講。你們先猜，這張片子要看什麼。
lines.en: I'll take the CT. First, guess what we're looking for on it.

question.zh: 為經導管主動脈瓣置換做計畫，電腦斷層要看哪些地方？
question.en: Planning a TAVI: what do you check on the CT?

answer.zh: 瓣環的大小與形狀、瓣膜鈣化的分布、冠狀動脈開口離瓣環多高（太低可能被擋住），以及從大腿到心臟的血管夠不夠粗、彎不彎、鈣化多不多。
answer.en: The size and shape of the annulus, where the valve calcium sits, how high the coronary openings are above the annulus (too low and they may be blocked), and whether the route from groin to heart is wide, straight and free enough of calcium.

post.zh: 瓣環大小適合，冠狀動脈夠高，兩邊大腿動脈都夠粗。經導管做得到。
post.en: Annulus size suits, coronaries high enough, both groin arteries wide enough. A catheter valve is feasible.

post.zh: 外科主動脈瓣置換也做得到。問題不是做不做得到，是哪個對她比較好。
post.en: Surgical valve replacement is feasible too. The question isn't can we, it's which is better for her.

lines.zh: 住院醫師，你建議什麼？
lines.en: Resident, what do you recommend?

q.en: What do you recommend to the meeting?

options.zh: 兩種都說明，依她的目標一起選
options.en: Present both; choose with her goals

why.zh: 對。84 歲、輕度衰弱、解剖適合，經導管是很好的選項；但建議要帶回給病人，用她聽得懂的話一起決定。
why.en: Right. At 84, mildly frail with suitable anatomy, a catheter valve is a strong option; but the recommendation goes back to her, in words she understands, to decide together.

options.zh: 開刀是標準，直接排外科置換
options.en: Surgery is the standard; book it

why.zh: 外科置換在年輕、低風險的人有優勢。對 84 歲衰弱的人，「標準」要看她是誰。
why.en: Surgery has the edge in younger, low-risk patients. At 84 and frail, "standard" depends on who she is.

why.zh: 有症狀的嚴重狹窄，藥物只能緩解，不能改變預後。年齡不是拒絕的理由，衰弱和她的意願才是要談的。
why.en: With symptomatic severe stenosis, drugs relieve but do not change the outlook. Age alone is no reason to refuse; frailty and her wishes are what to discuss.

post.zh: 我們吵了十年，這次一樣：建議經導管，但讓她選。
post.en: Ten years of arguing and the same answer: we recommend the catheter valve, but she chooses.

post.zh: 吃飯前，大家來綁十個結。物理治療師也來。
post.en: Before lunch, everyone ties ten knots. The physio too.

lines.zh: 換一個瓣膜要綁很多結，每一個都要跟第一個一樣好。手比腦先累。
lines.en: A valve takes a great many knots, and the last must be as good as the first. Hands tire before minds do.

lines.zh: 方醫師不用綁嗎？
lines.en: Doesn't Dr Fang have to tie?

lines.zh: 我用導管，不用打結。
lines.en: I use catheters. No knots.

lines.zh: 那是他十年來唯一贏我的地方。
lines.en: That's the only argument he's won in ten years.

note.zh: 機械瓣術後六週：胸骨與抗凝
note.en: Six weeks after a mechanical valve: sternum and anticoagulation

lines.zh: 醫師，我什麼時候可以回去甩鍋？店裡的二廚快哭了。
lines.en: Doctor, when can I toss a wok again? My sous-chef is close to tears.

lines.zh: 傷口乾淨，胸骨按壓不會動，也沒有喀喀聲。
lines.en: Wound clean, the sternum doesn't move when I press, no clicking.

lines.zh: 抗凝血的抽血有照時間做嗎？
lines.en: Are you keeping up with the anticoagulation blood tests?

lines.zh: 有，都記在小冊子上。藥一天都沒漏。
lines.en: Yes, all in the booklet. Not one day missed.

post.zh: 機械瓣的藥不能停。不舒服、要拔牙、要開刀，都先打電話。
post.en: With a mechanical valve the tablets never stop. Unwell, tooth out, any operation: phone us first.

guide.en: Teach sternal precautions and the road back

lines.zh: 胸骨還在癒合。這段時間胸骨保護：不單手提重鍋、不用力推門。
lines.en: The sternum is still healing. Sternal precautions for now: no heavy pans one-handed, no shoving doors.

lines.zh: 那我可以先切菜嗎？
lines.en: Can I start by chopping?

lines.zh: 可以，手肘貼近身體。甩鍋等回診評估，我們一步一步加。
lines.en: Yes, elbows close to the body. The wok waits for the next review; we add one step at a time.

note.zh: 阿嬤差點昏倒；選項談清楚了
note.en: Grandma nearly fainted; the options explained

guide.en: Talk options with Grandma and Wen

lines.zh: 阿嬤，有兩種方法換瓣膜。一種從大腿進去，一種開胸。團隊建議從大腿。
lines.en: Grandma, there are two ways to replace the valve: through the groin or by opening the chest. The team recommends the groin.

lines.zh: 從大腿？那我畫給你看我的嫁衣——
lines.en: The groin? Then let me show you my dress drawing—

lines.zh: 阿嬤一下子站起來去拿包包，臉色忽然發白，扶著桌子往下滑。
lines.en: Grandma springs up for her bag, goes suddenly white, and slides down holding the desk.

options.zh: 扶她平躺抬腿，量血壓、叫人
options.en: Lay her flat, legs up, BP, call

why.zh: 對。嚴重主動脈瓣狹窄的出口是固定的，突然站起來血壓就垮。平躺讓血回到心臟，再評估心律與意識。
why.en: Right. With severe aortic stenosis the outflow is fixed, so standing suddenly drops the pressure. Lying flat returns blood to the heart; then check rhythm and consciousness.

options.en: Give a nitroglycerin under the tongue

why.zh: 危險。血管擴張劑會讓狹窄病人的血壓垮得更厲害。
why.en: Dangerous. A vasodilator makes the pressure collapse further in a tight stenosis.

options.zh: 扶她走一走，讓血循環一下
options.en: Walk her around to get the blood moving

why.zh: 站著和用力正是她昏倒的原因。先躺下。
why.en: Standing and exertion are exactly what made her faint. Lie her down first.

post.zh: 阿嬤，這就是我記在手機裡的那種。
post.en: Grandma, that's exactly the kind I logged on my phone.

post.zh: 這就是為什麼不能再等。阿嬤，我們從大腿換，好不好？
post.en: And that's why we can't wait any longer. Grandma, through the groin. Shall we?

lines.zh: 同意書上寫她今天說的目標，也寫兩種方法各自的風險：中風、血管傷、需要心律調節器、漏。
lines.en: Put today's goal in the consent, and each option's risks: stroke, vessel injury, needing a pacemaker, leak.

lines.zh: 還有拔牙要先完成，日期由怡芳排。
lines.en: And the extraction comes first; Yi-fang books the dates.

note.zh: 病人的目標，寫進病歷第一行
note.en: The patient's goal, first line of the notes

lines.zh: 今天你學到什麼？
lines.en: What did you learn today?

lines.zh: 心臟團隊的第一個問題不是瓣膜多窄，是病人想要什麼。
lines.en: The heart team's first question isn't how tight the valve is. It's what the patient wants.

lines.zh: 還有：她站起來那一下，比任何超音波數字都清楚。
lines.en: And: the way she stood up said more than any echo number.

lines.zh: 這就是共享決策：我們帶選項，她帶她在乎的事。
lines.en: That is shared decision-making: we bring the options, she brings what matters.

guide.en: Dr Su brings up the meeting

lines.zh: 中午你建議直接排開刀。
lines.en: At noon you recommended booking surgery straight away.

lines.zh: 我以為外科置換是標準。
lines.en: I thought surgery was the standard.

lines.zh: 對六十歲是。對穿針不戴眼鏡、但走路稍慢的 84 歲，標準要問她。
lines.en: At sixty, yes. For an 84-year-old who threads needles without glasses but walks a little slow, the standard is her.

guide.en: Dr Su brings up the meeting

lines.zh: 中午你說她太老，吃藥就好。
lines.en: At noon you said she was too old; medication would do.

lines.zh: 我怕她受不了。
lines.en: I was afraid she couldn't take it.

lines.zh: 怕是對的。但下午她差點在你面前昏倒，藥擋不住那個。
lines.en: Fear is fair. But this afternoon she nearly fainted in front of you. Tablets don't stop that.

note.zh: 志豪切到手：壓住、不停藥
note.en: Chih-hao's cut finger: press, don't stop the tablets

sub.zh: 志豪：「我切菜切到手，一直滲血，藥要停嗎？」
sub.en: Chih-hao: "Cut my finger chopping, it keeps oozing. Should I stop the tablets?"

lines.zh: 醫師，我在家切菜切到手指，壓了一下還在滲。抗凝血藥要不要先停？
lines.en: Doctor, I cut my finger chopping at home. Pressed it a bit, still oozing. Should I stop the anticoagulant?

lines.zh: 不要停。機械瓣的藥一停，血栓的風險比手指大。
lines.en: Don't stop it. With a mechanical valve, stopping risks a clot that matters far more than the finger.

lines.zh: 乾淨的布用力壓、手舉高，壓久一點不要偷看。壓不住、傷口很深或頭暈，就來急診。
lines.en: Clean cloth, press firmly, hand up, and keep pressing without peeking. If it won't stop, it's deep or you feel faint, come to the ER.

lines.zh: ……停了。二廚說我切菜比甩鍋危險。
lines.en: ...it's stopped. My sous-chef says I'm more dangerous chopping than tossing.

lines.zh: 小雯傳來一張照片：阿嬤在燈下描嫁衣的版型，袖口那朵玉蘭已經畫好了。
lines.en: Wen sends a photo: Grandma under the lamp tracing the dress pattern, the cuff magnolia already drawn.

lines.zh: 值班結束。明天怡芳會排拔牙；春天還很遠，但不是太遠。
lines.en: End of shift. Tomorrow Yi-fang books the extraction. Spring is a way off, but not too far.

sub.zh: 一顆牙先拔，一個瓣膜再換，一件嫁衣慢慢縫
sub.en: A tooth first, then a valve, and a dress sewn slowly
